FOREWORD `I-his Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. Fenoxaprop-p-ethyi technical is employed in the preparation of herbicidal formulations for agricultural use. (1S0)

Fenoxaprop-p-ethyl is the common name accepted by the International Organization for Standardization for (D+ )-ethyl-2 -[4-( 6-chloro-2-benzoxazoly loxy)-phenoxy] propanoate as given below. In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the provisions of Ztmecticide Act, 1968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However this standard is subject to restrictions imposed under the Act and Rules wherever applicable. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2: 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values (revised)'. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

IS 15232:2002 7 TESTS 7.1 Tests shall be carried out by the methods referred in COI4 and 5 of Table 1. 7.2 Quality of Reagents

Unless specified otherwise, pure chemicals and distilled water (see IS 1070) shall be employed in tests.
NOTE -- `Pure chemicals' shall mean chemicals that do not contain impurities, which affect the results of analysis.

ANNEX A [Table 1, S1 No. (i)]
DETERMINATION A-1 PRINCIPLE A-1. I High Performance Liquid Chromatography (H PLC), is being used for the determination of active ingredient, fenoxaprop-p-ethyl content. After dilution of the sample, fenoxaprop-p-ethyl content is determined by comparing the response of the sample with that of a fenoxaprop-p-ethyl standard of known purity by HPLC on a column packed with silica by external standard technique. A-2 APPARATUS A-2.1 Liquid Chromatography -- A suitable instrument for use with stainless steel columns and capable of maintaining pressure of 150 bars, fitted with a 20 m icrolitre loop injector. A-2.2 Detector -- UV spectrophotometer capable to measure UV absorption at 237 nm. Check its linearity in the concentration zone used for the determination. A-2.3 Liquid Chromatographic Column -- Stainless steel, 250 mm long, 4.6 mm internal diameter packed with 5 mm silica, Lichrosorb SibO,5 pm (Merck). A-2.4 [ntegrator-cum-plotter A-2.5 Liquid Chromatography Conditions -- The conditions given below are typical. Conditions may have to be adjusted to obtain optimum results from a given apparatus provided standardization is done: Column temperature : Ambient : 1.5 to 2.0 ml/min Weigh out accurately (to the nearest O.I mg,) an amount 2 : 237 nm OF FENOXAPROP-P-ETHYL Approximate Run time A-3 REAGENTS A-3.1 Fenoxaprop-p-EthyI -- of known purity. A-3.2 lso-Octane or equivalent. Reference Standard CONTENT retention time : 11.0 min

: 20.0 min

�- HPLC grade internal standard

A-3.3 1, 4 Dioxane -- HPLC grade or equivalent (containing O.15 percent water). A-3.4 HPLC Mobile Phase -- Mix iso-octane with 1, 4 dioxane (containing 0.15 percent water) in the ratio of 97 : 3 (v/v), homogenize and degas before use. A-4 PROCEDURE A-4.1 Preparation of Standard Solution

Weigh out accurately (to the nearest 0.1 mg) an amount of substance containing approximately 120 mg fenoxaprop-p-ethyl reference substance into a 100 m I volumetric flask, dissolve in 30 ml dioxane, add approximately 60-ml No-octane, a Ilow to come to equilibrium at room temperature and make up to the mark with iso-octane. Pipette out 10 ml of this solution into another 100-ml volumetric flask, add 7.5-ml of dioxane and makeup to the mark with iso-octane A-4.2 Preparation of Sample Solution
